Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,json,urllib.parse,time
# Search issues for recent summary using GitHub issues search unauth (curl worked)
queries=['repo:mruby/mruby "heap-buffer-overflow" "dispatch"','repo:mruby/mruby "1-byte" "codegen.c"','repo:mruby/mruby "dispatch(s" "heap-buffer-overflow"','repo:mruby/mruby "oss-fuzz" "dispatch" "codegen.c"']
for q in queries:
 print('QUERY',q)
 url='https://api.github.com/search/issues?q='+urllib.parse.quote(q)
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'openhands'})
 try:
  data=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30))
  print('total',data.get('total_count'))
  for it in data.get('items',[])[:10]: print(it['number'],it['title'],it['html_url'])
 except Exception as e: print('ERR',e)
